name: Inma Gakuen ~Seito Kaichou "Sendou Ayaka" no no Funtou RPG~
original_name: 淫魔学園～生徒会長『千堂彩華』の奮闘RPG～
source:
With the abrupt appearance of an evil poltergeist,
mayhem is breaking out around the academy.
The player must control student council president
Ayaka Sendou and seal away the evil once more!!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ210624.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 邪恶的幽灵突然现身，学院周围顿时陷入一片混乱。玩家必须操控学生会长千堂彩华，再次封印邪灵！[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ210624.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
